title: Trace molecular chelation engineering of a self-healing hybrid interphase for highly stable aqueous zinc-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05118E, Paper
Hongbo Wu, Gongxun Lu, Chang Dong, Tao Yang, Zeyang Sun, Zhijin Ju, Chengbin Jin, Ouwei Sheng, Dexin Yang, Tianyu Shen, Haojie Ji, Jian Zhang, Guangmin Zhou, Xuefeng Zhang
Molecular chelation-driven interface engineering employs polar groups to lower water activity by H-bond reorganization and Zn2+ chelation, forming a PSZ/inorganic SEI hybrid layer that enables adaptive corrosion protection and suppressed degradation.
